summary.text: Samuel (Sam) Gallucci is the Republican nominee for California's 26th Congressional District. He is a pastor in Oxnard and a business executive, and he previously ran in the 2021 California gubernatorial recall election. His ballot designation is Business Executive/Pastor.

paragraphs.text: Ran as a Republican candidate on the 2021 California gubernatorial recall replacement ballot, receiving 18,134 votes, according to JoinCalifornia.
He and his wife, Toni, are listed as lead pastors of Embrace Church in Oxnard on the church's website.
JoinCalifornia lists him as married to Toni with three sons.
